title: Break results down before fixing
statement: Before choosing a fix or calling a change a gain, break results down by item type, unit and failure kind, and apply changes only where they help: averages hide losses.
example: One gate abandoned a change if any key item type fell 5 points or more, however the overall score moved.
detail: A synthesis across five corpora of the AP work makes dimension-aware debugging a first-tier rule: every failed result maps to a failed dimension and item type before any fix is chosen, because jumping from an aggregate score to retraining had wasted days and each item type failed for its own reasons (`MASTER_SYNTHESIS.md`, lines 264, 280 and 281). One step-function gate compared each critical item type with its baseline and marked a change dead if any fell by 5 points or more, even when the overall score held (the step-function gate's `source_report.md`, lines 51 and 58). Size each fix by its criterion's share of your own failures, and stop on a collapse in any one item type.
against: The short-answer drop may be noise: the project's own bar for a real change on that item type is "- SAQ/MCQ_SET: need **>4pp**" (icloud-work/aptraining/workspace/comms/from_shadow/2026-04-30T1700Z_comprehensive_lessons_learned.md, 143). The unit finding is one measurement whose raw report is outside this evidence, and the targeted fix has no recorded result; the same file says that measurement alone "could be SAQ-specific" (`icloud-work/auto-memory-backup/feedback_data_ceiling_not_capacity_ceiling.md`, line 12). The note on failure overlap sits in a file marked low confidence and conflicted (`icloud-work/auto-memory-backup/project_warm_start_hurts.md`, lines 7 and 9). The same ruling kept part of the literature view, that the model had the capacity, and found the training data kept it from being used (`icloud-work/auto-memory-backup/MEMORY_GOVERNANCE.md`, line 98). That the literature fix touches only citation is itself an assumption, and the cut to +0-5 points is a projection whose test is not recorded. The lab's pipeline guide takes the opposite general line, that the raw model is one component and the pipeline the multiplier, and the notes give no sample sizes. The overall effect was within noise ('Aggregate +0.67pp / cell-routed +1.33pp APUSH (within noise) but per-cell direction is reusable.', `icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/memory/MEMORY.md`, line 198), and the two entries disagree on whether short-answer items gained, with top-3 facts, or lost, with a richer context. Supplying the real source documents themselves helped the document-based type (`icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/memory/STATE_CURRENT_2026_05_12T0805Z.md`, line 88), so the rule is about added background facts, not the source texts.
